mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_sync_config SET knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId}, sync_type = #{syncType}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, enabled = #{enabled}, last_sync_at = #{lastSyncAt}, last_sync_status = #{lastSyncStatus}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_sync_config WHERE id = #{id})
